annotations.description: Inline formatting, links and mentions over `text`.

childrenType.description: How this block lays out its children — a children type such as `Unordered` or `Grid`.

columnCount.description: Number of columns the children occupy when `childrenType` is `Grid`.

attributes.description: Parent-layout attributes for the section under the heading.

description: A section heading whose children are the section; its level comes from nesting depth.
